entry.label: Practice: Multi-methodology: justify the move from one method to another
entry.description: Design a short inquiry in which each method answers a different question and its output is translated carefully into the next. A basic methodological design exercise. There is no universal correct sequence. The checks concern fit, assumptions and transitions, not allegiance to one classification of methods.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Separate the questions that require different kinds of inquiry.
Specify the transition into the numerical model.
Set a trigger to change your method design.
common_misreadings: A worked comparison is not the only acceptable answer to an open question.
